a_minor.notes: A minor pentatonic is always safe; B (2nd) and F (b6) are scale colour.

b_minor.notes: B minor pentatonic anchors; C# (2nd) and G (b6) are careful colour.

c_major.notes: C major pentatonic; F (4th) and B (7th) can clash on the wrong chord.

d_dorian.notes: Plays minor-ish; D minor pentatonic safe. B is the dorian natural 6 — careful.

e_major.notes: E major pentatonic; A (4th) and D# (7th) are careful colour.

e_phrygian.notes: Plays minor-ish; E minor pentatonic safe. F is the phrygian b2 — careful.

f_lydian.notes: Plays major-ish; F major pentatonic safe. B is the lydian #4 — careful.

g_major.notes: G major pentatonic; C (4th) and F# (7th) are careful colour.

g_mixolydian.notes: Plays major-ish; G major pentatonic safe. F is the mixolydian b7 — careful.
